tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment (s) similar to the type specified in the ‘Schedule of Requirements’ up to at least xxxx % of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after xxxxx and be in satisfactory operation for xxxxx months as on date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer , has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least xxxxx % of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least xxxxx months on the date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.

Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three/five years2 and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

Bidder should furnish copy of the Registration document where the ompany Proprietorship Partnership is registered under Indian Companies Act 1956 or 2013Partnership Act 1932 Shops and Establishment Act Limited Liability Partnership Proprietorship and must be active in market for at least 5 years prior to the date of tender.Bidder shall be authorized dealer and shall submit Manufacturer Authorization Form MAF in prescribed format, in Annexure 4.If Bidder is OEM declaration shall be furnished to that effect in Annexure 4. Separate MAF shall be submitted for each OEM.As four products are procured, MAFs from up to four OEMs are permitted.Web camera and conference speakerphone may be sourced from different OEMs seperate MAF shall be submitted for respective items. The quoted products shall be commercial businessenterprise grade models and shall comply with all technical specifications prescribed in the tender. OEM shall certify that the quoted models are commercial enterprise grade and not consumer grade

The bidder should have ISO 9001 Certification Possess a valid ISO 9001 2015 (or latest version) certification for QMS.ISO 27001 Certification (Recommended): Possess a valid ISO 27001 2013 (or latest version) certification for ISMS.OEM Certifications: BIS Certification for Monitor OEM ISO certifications ISO 9001 Mandatory ISO 27001 Mandatory for OEMs supplying active electronic devices (camera, speakerphone)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If Bidder is an OEM - should have supplied the equipment similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the quantity required and if bidder is a trader, should have supplied at least 30% of the required quantity of similar equipment in any one of the last 3 years. The equipment offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design.The bidders should have 3 Years experience in supply and integration of IT / AV / VC equipment to a Central or State Government / Urban Local Bodies/Government Departments / Public Sector Companies in India. Performance certificate to be Enclosed

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a reputed system integrator / IT or AV solution provider
OEM shall be a reputed manufacturer of commercial enterprisegrade IT or AV quipment with minimum 5 years market presence.

The quoted product model shall not be End-of-Sale (EOS) or End-of-Life (EOL) on the date of bid submission. The OEM shall ensure availability of warranty support, technical support and spare parts throughout the warranty period. If the quoted model reaches EOS/EOL during the warranty period, equivalent or higher model support/replacement shall be provided at no additional cost to the Department.

Company Information shall be furnished as per Annexure-5. Bidder/ OEM should have Corporate/ Regional office with good service and technical support team with authorized service centres with minimum of 2 service engineers in each of the service centres in the State of Karnataka or undertake to open a service office in Karnataka in case it becomes the successful bidder within 45 days of award of contract.
The bidder shall provide local technical support in Bengaluru and nominate a single point of contact.
The bidder should not have been blacklisted by any organization of Karnataka or in any other State Government or Central Government or PSU undertakings.
